title: "DAG falsification"
format:
  html:
    mermaid:
      theme: forest
---


```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

  T[Treatment:<br/>current neighbor / current stranger / former neighbor]
  P[Phase:<br/>playback vs post-stimulus]

  U[Latent pair state:<br/>bond strength, territory value,<br/>breeding state, baseline aggressiveness]
  I1[Perceived intruder threat / recognition<br/>at t-1]
  I2[Perceived intruder threat / recognition<br/>at t]

  R1[Response intensity at t-1<br/>(song + proximity)]
  R2[Response intensity at t<br/>(song + proximity)]

  T --> I1
  T --> I2

  P --> I1
  P --> I2

  U --> I1
  U --> I2

  I1 --> R1
  I2 --> R2

  R1 --> R2
  I1 --> I2

  classDef latent fill:#FCE5CD,stroke:#A66A00,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#000;
  classDef obs fill:#D9EAF7,stroke:#3A6EA5,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#000;

  class U,I1,I2 latent;
  class T,P,R1,R2 obs;
```
